summary: Log cabin lookout (1927) replaced by an R-6 cab on a 10-ft tower in 1959; tower removed 1989 (one source says 1980); now Nez Perce NF, site gone.

corrections.proposed: Nez Perce National Forest (Bitterroot National Forest until 1957)
corrections.why: Weebly records the 1957 transfer of the site's administration to the Nez Perce National Forest. The record lists only the earlier forest.

firelookout.com and the Forest Service post both give a 10-foot tower (about 3.0 m). The 9.1 m (30 ft) figure appears in none of the sources read. A Forest Service table says 12 feet (about 3.7 m); see resolved_conflicts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Service post give 1927. A 1955 condition report, quoted on Weebly, says probably about 1926. The story uses 1927 and notes the 1926 estimate.
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1980. firelookout.com, Weebly, the Forest Service post and the Forest Service table give 1989. The story uses 1989.

The Forest Service post says the old log cupola structure was removed after the new lookout was completed in 1959. The Forest Service table says it was removed in the 1970s. Both are shown in the story.

The new cab stood on a 10-foot tower per firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, Weebly and the Forest Service post. The Forest Service table says 12 feet. A 1965 USGS station description gives the roof as flat and 20 feet high, which may describe the cab roof rather than the tower. The story says most accounts give 10 feet.

notes_for_editor: Brief's agency (Bitterroot) predates the 1957 transfer, and its 9.1 m height matches no source, so two corrections are proposed. Dates and heights conflict across sources; the story and resolved_conflicts show which values were used. The Forest Service post is a Facebook page; it was cached and read through fetch_text. Nothing in the sources read describes the site today; the 1965 USGS station description is historical only.
